title: Hydraulically feasible regeneration-reserve-aware hydrogen pressure swing adsorption under uncertainty with staged membrane polishing and a quantum-ready probability event
description: Reproducibility package for a pressure-consistent dynamic hydrogen PSA, staged polymer and palladium polishing, public-data validation, uncertainty analysis, a verified 66-logical-qubit portable OpenQASM oracle, and an exact two-bit final-event truth-mapping probe executed over all 64 inputs on IBM Kingston.
notes: IBM job db6emt04qg6s73c4lja0 used the free Open Plan for 7 QPU seconds. All 64 two-bit final-event states were majority-correct at 256 shots per state. This is a basis-state truth-mapping test, not coherent QAE or quantum advantage.
